name: @titanforge/ui
description: Browser UI: a from-scratch Canvas 2D flamegraph and service map (no charting library), plus a search box driving @titanforge/query-lang against @titanforge/server's /api/query. Pure layout math lives in flamegraph-layout.ts/service-map-layout.ts (unit tested); canvas drawing is thin, untested glue — same split as the rest of this repo's pure-vs-glue convention.
